$comment: Dependency manifest for skill-route. Every skill the router can emit MUST
appear here. skill-route --doctor reads this to detect phantom routes.
'generated'  — produced by a build step (gstack hosts/*.ts). Do NOT vendor:
a copy goes stale on the next upstream update and loses the
host-specific frontmatter. Declared as a plugin dependency.
'vendored'   — hand-authored, stable. Copied into vendor/ by --bundle so the
plugin is self-contained on a machine without them.

generated_deps.install: git clone https://github.com/garrytan/gstack && cd gstack && ./setup --host auto
